result.summary: Use one exclusively leased llama.cpp slot as the resident cache, with a shared host adapter for both Accord Runtime and PythonSDK. Begin each episode with cache_prompt=false, reuse only its exact authorized repository prefix in subsequent actor calls, and record timings.cache_n rather than tokens_cached. A frozen 2×2 pilot with two episodes per cell can demonstrate actual parent/two-child execution and cache feasibility, but cannot establish language superiority or general coding success. The existing snapshot benchmark and runtime APIs support this design; no resident-cache experiment was executed by this worker.

conclusions.claim: Resident implementation: run the pinned server with one slot, --cache-ram 0, --no-cache-idle-slots, --cache-reuse 0, --no-context-shift, no --slot-save-path, and the same frozen model/template/context/batch/KV configuration for every arm. Hold an exclusive episode lease over slot 0. Send the complete rendered prompt on every request. The first real parent request uses cache_prompt=false and both performs useful work and populates engine KV; subsequent parent/child requests use true only in shared arms. Disabled arms use false for every request. No save, restore, prefix snapshot, or per-child prefix prime is necessary. The source calculates the previous/new prompt token common prefix and retains that slot state directly. Ordinary transcript/result files are separate from engine KV.

Cache identity and authorization: create an opaque host-owned handle bound to server process generation, slot lease, root task/namespace, exact common-prefix token IDs and length, source content hashes/revisions, engine/model/tokenizer/template profile, context geometry, KV types, positional/adapter settings and relevant generation settings. A child receives use permission only if its live task input scope already includes every source in that prefix; a handle must never enlarge task authority. Models receive neither slot administration nor arbitrary cache APIs. Validate the immutable full-input description first, then resolve the handle. Revoke/invalidate on ancestor cancellation, namespace/profile/source change, lease loss or process restart. Discard each previous actor's divergent suffix through the normal exact-prefix path. Cache unavailability may fall back to full input only after normal input/authorization checks; unauthorized or stale inputs are rejected, not rescued by fallback.

Token and measurement invariants: render the shared repository context before actor-specific instructions and preserve each prepared worker_context unchanged in the suffix. Tokenize complete prompts using the actual engine profile, verify the shared prefix elementwise, and record each actual prompt's hash and length. Ensure adjacent actor prompts diverge after the declared prefix, or compute and report their larger actual common prefix. Require first-request and disabled-arm timings.cache_n=0; require subsequent shared requests to reuse the documented prefix; require cache_n + prompt_n = actual complete input token count, no context truncation and no context shifting. The source may re-evaluate one token if an entire prompt is already cached, so avoid identical whole prompts or account for that behavior explicitly. Final tokens_cached is retained state, not admission reuse. Record server prompt/generation times, client TTFT/total, reused/evaluated/generated tokens, request bytes and effective settings.

Fair baseline: cross lifecycle backend (Contract→Runtime versus ordinary JobSpec→PythonSDK) with resident sharing enabled/disabled. Both backends must call the same model transport/cache adapter, use the same source input, actor workflow, materializer, validators, budgets, namespace policy and sampling/stop limits. Use one input representation for the whole primary experiment, preferably complete rendered text; token IDs would introduce an unnecessary third factor. Keep backend names and benchmark arm labels out of model prompts. Existing Runtime and PythonSDK already accept model callbacks and enforce analogous child scope, budget and validator rules. The comparison measures incremental lifecycle/IR behavior and overhead; any shared-cache speedup belongs to the common inference service. A supplied fixed workflow does not measure model authoring of a language or SDK.

Bounded real delegation: freeze one genuine defect task, such as normalizing Contract.parse's unpaired-Unicode input error without changing other error precedence. A four-call episode is concrete: parent proposes a bounded plan; implementation child returns the restricted replacement source span; review child examines the proposed change and gives evidence; parent makes a final adoption decision. Host code performs exact materialization and independent frozen behavioral tests in a disposable copy. Both child results must be structurally valid and independently acceptable before integration. Count at most four primary generations per episode and no hidden repair loop. Eight episodes imply at most 32 primary generations and 16 prepared child packages; failed prerequisites can terminate an episode early and must remain reported. If the parent is deterministic host code instead of an actual model actor, describe the experiment as a host with two model workers and do not claim three-agent model execution.

Agents-Core is part of the real measured exchange: prepare each model child with get_subagent_context, require prepared, retain the original contract, pass worker_context unchanged, and validate the unchanged generated result with validate_subagent_result before using it. Do not wrap a tiny model answer in a host-fabricated completed worker envelope, copy evidence claims into a fake successful result, or strip identity fields. New execution attempts require new preparation/attempt IDs; invalid results remain failures unless an explicitly budgeted correction is made and revalidated. Measure package creation, package bytes/tokens, validation and any orchestration repair separately. Required unique contract/attempt identities can make otherwise matched arm prompts differ: put them after the reusable prefix, retain exact prompts and token counts, and report this nuisance rather than claiming byte-identical episodes. Do not reuse one package across different new attempts merely to force prompt identity.

Protect experiment integrity during code materialization: never execute the model's shell commands or an arbitrary returned module. Use a trusted materializer that accepts only the frozen target path, base-source digest and bounded span, rejects added files/path traversal and changes outside the allowed region, and verifies the final diff. A syntax check alone is insufficient. Before running code, enforce a narrowly specified AST allowlist for the replacement and execute the candidate only inside the chosen disposable, network-restricted subprocess with timeout and constrained filesystem authority. Freeze positive and negative tests before scored calls: malformed UTF-8 bytes, actual unpaired-surrogate strings, escaped JSON surrogates, valid Unicode, exact byte-size boundaries, duplicate keys and existing semantic-error precedence. Review output is evidence to inspect, not a substitute for independent tests. Merely moving the existing size require into the broad ValueError handler risks converting contract-too-large errors into invalid-contract-JSON errors.

Episode order and sample size: predeclare A=Accord/shared, B=Python/shared, C=Accord/disabled, D=Python/disabled and an eight-episode reverse-block order such as A,B,C,D,D,C,B,A, with each episode beginning from zero reusable prompt KV. Give both blocks the same declared hardware/kernel warmup policy and keep weights loaded throughout. This balances early/late positions and reverses pair direction, but is not complete predecessor counterbalancing. Record timestamps and system/process observations; report each episode and block rather than a significance test. Four balanced permutations, sixteen episodes, would improve order control but exceed the proposed minimal two-repetition pilot. Earlier text/ID results changed materially under a separate order control, making this limitation load-bearing.

Separate mechanical feasibility from open-loop quality: report strict worker-envelope validity, code-materialization validity, independent patch correctness, reviewer correctness, adoption correctness, end-to-end completion, and output text/token identity as different outcomes. Cache-dependent batching can change logits even at temperature zero. Live implementation outputs can consequently change later review/adoption prompts and generation length, so end-to-end timing differences combine reuse with different trajectories. Raw cache_n/prompt_n and per-stage prompt times provide the most direct reuse evidence. Optionally add a separately declared fixed-input transport control for clean latency attribution, but label it replay/control and exclude it from actual delegation success counts. Eight episodes of one defect remain one distinct task, not eight independent capability tasks.

Report costs at two boundaries: full episode wall time includes the first real parent's cold prefill, all successful and failed generations, runtime/SDK work, package preparation/validation, materialization and independent checks; steady per-request engine timing is supplementary. Report common model startup and warmups separately, and include any cache-specific setup in amortized totals. Resident reuse avoids the old snapshot save/restore/hash costs, but does not reduce the logical context size or remove the need to send complete prompts through this endpoint. Record process CPU and sampled RSS with their limits; RSS is not unified GPU memory or energy. If calls remain local, measured provider charges are zero, while electricity, hardware and orchestration-model costs remain unmeasured unless independently captured. Do not infer currency savings from evaluated-token savings.

Preflight negative controls should verify wrong namespace/owner, unauthorized child scope, cancelled ancestor, wrong model/template/source profile, changed prefix IDs, stale process/lease and cache loss. All authorization/profile mismatches must fail before dispatch; the explicit cache-miss fallback must evaluate the full valid prompt with cache_n=0. Record an HTTP route allowlist or equivalent trace confirming zero save/restore calls and zero cache snapshot files. These controls establish the trusted host's local policy, not an authenticated multitenant inference server. A serial slot proves resident reuse across logical actors; it does not prove parallel sibling execution, copy-on-write KV forks, cross-process KV exchange or cross-model portability.
